approach: Scaffold the skills/enhance/ node from the CR 35 design draft, resolving its five blocking findings, and carry the new stale-detection path in the same node. The corpus gap and the CR's behavior are one subject; splitting them would spec the skill twice.
Blast radius: one shipped skill body, one shipped reference file, the spec corpus, and the docs page. Published package changes, so a changeset is owed.
The frozen Delegation wording is not touched. This CR changes when the canonical text is surfaced, never what it says.
Stale is a recognizable earlier form of the addition, not semantic proximity. The user's own prose is covered, never stale.

why: Cold spec-judge returns ALIGNED with oracle, builder and architect all passing on round two. Round one blocked at governance pre-flight and graded no lens: the conductor authored inline without the lifecycle and gate-validation governances and without the plugin-tier builder bar the project registry names for artifact-type skill, the same miss that failed CR 35's first round. Composing that bar surfaced two shipped rules with no scenario, both now covered; the second is a barred row rather than a use-case extension because no decision in the drawn graph reaches a file outside the agent configuration, and the judge traced the graph and confirmed it. The node also closes the corpus gap CR 35 left open, resolving all five of its blocking findings. Suite and spec-state checks clean, 26 scenarios, map 1:1 by manual trace. Self-asserted within the derived auto-spec leash.

what: Staleness is anchored on spans matched character for character, so a repository that took the earlier wording and then hand-edited a clause carries no surviving span and is never offered the current text. The impl gate built this case and confirmed it. It is a deliberate trade rather than a defect: the node states that a missed offer costs nothing while overwriting the owner's own words is the expensive failure, and no frozen scenario requires catching a locally edited copy. Worth revisiting if consumers turn out to edit an addition in place more often than expected.

why: Twenty-five of twenty-six frozen scenarios pass across five rounds. The safety scenario, which requires the skill to leave alone a section it cannot tell from the owner's own words, failed in rounds two through five. Each round the judge built an owner-voiced section that satisfied the criterion standing at the time, and each fix was verified against every earlier counter-example, so no hole was traded for another. Round five classifies its finding a second consecutive recurrence of the provenance class and argues the mechanism rather than the chosen span is unsound: a distinctive phrase is reproducible by anyone who has read this package's documentation. That premise was checked against a hand-maintained instruction file outside this repository and found to be false as the criterion assumes it. The remaining choice is between accepting a mis-offer risk, writing a provenance marker on approval which helps no repository that already carries the earlier wording, and offering the difference without asserting whose text it is, which would narrow a frozen scenario and fires Clearance. That is the owner's call, so the gate pauses.

what: Contradicts this mission's own completion claim: the stale-detection path is specified and its skill body shipped, but the criterion that decides staleness does not yet meet the frozen safety scenario. Deciding how a shipped addition proves a section descends from it is the open question. Three candidates were reached: accept a verbatim-span match with its mis-offer risk; have the skill write a provenance marker when it writes an addition, which is sound but does nothing for the repositories already carrying the earlier wording, who are the population the issue names; or drop the provenance claim entirely and offer the difference for the owner to judge, which needs a frozen scenario narrowed and so needs clearance. Filed on the forge.

The tiebreak treats a score from a noisy instrument as decisive. The evaluation is many model runs and a one-point margin flips the outcome, with no error band stated anywhere. The tie rule gives the repository's own wording the benefit of the doubt, which points the right way and covers most of it, but whether a margin needs a band before more additions ship is an open question rather than a settled one. Raised by the spec judge as a strategist observation and held out of this change deliberately.

why: Re-open of a frozen suite, cleared by the repository owner in session, after the implementation failed one frozen scenario across four impl-gate rounds. The mechanism it was failing compared a present section against a description of the retired wording, and any description short enough to author proved short enough for someone to reach independently, so the false-positive rate was not a parameter that could be lowered. The owner directed comparing against the retired wording itself, kept verbatim, and adding a fourth outcome where the skill asks instead of deciding. The judge graded the re-open justified on its merits rather than on that direction, and returns ALIGNED on round two with all three lenses passing. Round one failed builder on one unsettleable assertion and raised a boundary stated as an unmeasurable proportion that contradicted the suite instantiating it; the boundary is now two structural predicates, and every finding, content gap and cheap observation was taken before freezing. Thirty-six scenarios, suite and spec-state checks clean, six fixtures verified blind. Self-asserted within the derived auto-spec leash.

what: The staleness rule is stated per retired wording and the suite quantifies existentially over them, so there is no rule for combining results across two or more. Unreachable while one wording is retired, and no fixture can reach it, so it was deliberately deferred rather than guessed. The event that makes it live is the next revision of the offered text, which is the same event the whole capability exists to serve, so the rule wants naming before that revision rather than after. Raised by the spec judge as the shape the next reopen would take.

why: Second reopen of the suite, cleared by the owner, after the impl gate failed one frozen scenario three runs of three. The criterion stated two binary predicates and enumerated three of their four combinations; the missing case, a sentence-for-sentence reword keeping the order, had no rule and every run improvised out of the branch the suite mandated. The owner chose to route it to the undecided branch and to have a replacement name the owner-authored paragraphs it would delete. The rule is now closed form over both predicates with a totality clause promoted into it, so the four cases are exhaustive and a missing one would be visible. Judge returns ALIGNED on the second round with all three lenses passing and no findings; the first found an under-determined guard that made one scenario contradict two others, and a decisive rule with no scenario, both fixed. It also ruled the Clearance repair proof satisfied and corrected its instrument: at this gate the object is the pre-repair contract, not the pre-repair implementation, and the proof is that the retired scenario and its replacement demand opposite verdicts on one constructible state. Thirty-nine scenarios, checks clean, ten fixtures verified blind including one built to isolate the quoted-sentence rule after the judge showed the first was over-determined. Self-asserted within the derived auto-spec leash.

what: Revisions of an addition's offered text are now verified when they are made: the change retiring a wording must append it to the history file and add scenarios for its revision shape. That duty is stated only in prose, and the wording is owned by a repo-private evaluation skill that could change the fenced text without opening a change request against this node. A repository check failing when the offered text changes without matching changes to the history file and the suite would enforce it mechanically. Deferred as backlog: no revision is pending.

why: Third reopen of the suite, cleared by the repository owner in session on each of its decisions: the placement assertion is loosened to outside-the-managed-region, the already-current check is containment, and future revision shapes are verified when a revision is made rather than specified in advance. Pre-repair proof for the placement narrowing is unmet and cannot be met, since removing an assertion never makes the pre-repair contract fail; it is waived by the owner on the evidence that the frozen node spec, its scenario map and the shipped reference all already said outside the managed region, so the suite is brought back into line with its own spec rather than bent toward the implementation. The ACED spec judge returns ALIGNED with all three lenses passing and all forty-three scenarios passing, rebuilt the corpus-state table for today's single retired wording and found every row right, and ruled the revision-time rescope sound under no premature commitment. Its two content gaps were taken before freezing. The earlier two spec gate lines for owner-cleared reopens recorded the approval as the agent's; this line and the correction in the plan log record that the reopens were the owner's.
